boundary_and_censor_algorithm.optional_cohort_extrema: For each k from0 through possible-only count, add k smallest lower bounds for minimum mean and k largest upper bounds for maximum mean to definite cohort sums. Keep extremizing denominators; ignore empty means. No favorable optional additions to minimum sample gate.
boundary_and_censor_algorithm.censor: Valid observation ends before crossing: TT lower=max(0,observation_end-start_upper), upper=unbounded; serialize upper as null with bound_state=unbounded, never JSON Infinity or missing_observation.
boundary_and_censor_algorithm.worst_case_reference: Unbounded reference upper or unresolved conservative contrast prevents support; valid uncertainty=>not_resolved.
boundary_and_censor_algorithm.coherence: No mutually incompatible favorable memberships across bins; independent per-bin worst-case bounds are conservative.

sensitivity_acceptance: All14 required cases must support in addition to primary. Any unsupported, indeterminate or seed-disagreeing case=>not_resolved. Acceptance is stricter than primary10%/.95/180s alone. No Cartesian sweep or favorable substitution.
persistence240_rule: Require4 consecutive speed-qualified60s bins and an embedded3-consecutive-bin180s subblock meeting original R/RU conditions.

failure_classification.observed_insertion_blockage_or_entry_bot: qualified observations but intended comparison fails =>not_resolved
failure_classification.technical_failure: preserve attempt as technical_failed; no scientific negative invented
failure_classification.unfavorable_seed: retain key; no replacement or phenomenon-driven retry
